Messages.Author: echiang
Messages.Body:
Lately, there's been an obsession over Enkil Cog, and the obscene eBay prices it has been commanding.

I wonder if Enkil Cog has now topped Summon History as the most valuable card in VTES? What do you think?

I think it's amusing that just one or two years ago, many players thought that Summon History was worth more than Enkil Cog and were eagerly swapping their Cogs for Histories.

But I think now a lot of people are finally realizing that while a Summon History deck is funny, there's really not much use for it outside of Trujah and Ian Forestal, while Enkil Cog can fit into a wider variety of decks.

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
> echiang wrote:
> I wonder if Enkil Cog has now topped Summon History as the most valuable card in VTES? What do you think?
>
I'm of the opinion that they were never in competition. Enkil Cog has always been more valuable and harder for people to part with.

If you have 2 Summon History, you put one in your collection binder, and never expect to play the other one. It is easy to trade or sell.

If you have 2 Enkil Cog, they go into and out of 3 different decks every play session.

Enkil Cog would definitely make it into my 20th anniversary kit, if I were planning one.

Messages.Author: KevinM
Messages.Body:
> echiang wrote:
> I wonder if Enkil Cog has now topped Summon History as the most valuable card in VTES? What do you think?
>
Before it was reprinted, War Ghoul went for $40, easy. Summon History was never in this league.

I encountered a player years ago who sold me all his stuff for cheap and he had amassed two sets of Sabbat and *14 sets* of Sabbat War. I put every single one of those War Ghoul up on eBay, as well as the five I owned, and not a single one sold for less than $35. Some sold for near $50, especially the "3x War Ghoul" auctions I had running.

Conversely, I wanted 10x Summon History for a deck and only owned six. I got the other four for no more than $20 each.

Enkil Cog does have high play value and can be a bit of a "trick", especially with Strike:Combat Ends + untap, but it remains to be seen if it has the staying power of War Ghoul. If VTES isn't republished sometime soon, I'd think that it will.
